description: Navigation to a malformed URL (missing scheme + typo) silently became a search. Re-interpret what the user meant.

antiPatterns.reason: User already confirmed — clarify would be unnecessary friction.

expected.successRubric: Correct the typo (githhub → github) and navigate. No clarify needed — the previous error message already proposed the fix and the user agreed.

content: The user confirmed that "githhub.com" should be navigated to, and they said "yes that". The previous navigation failed because the URL was missing a scheme. I should try again with the correct URL: https://github.com</think>
